title: The coefficient inverse-image identification normalizes the strict Roos augmentation
statement: Fix prime ell, finite E/Q_ell and an isomorphism g:X to Y. Let K_T=R_T[0] be the regular completed integral complex. The coefficient model maps are the specified maps of [lem-pod-canonical-coefficient-model-maps]. Let I_g be the exact sectionwise inverse-image functor on completed modules [lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image]. Define c:I_g(K_Y) isomorphic to K_X by the single-complex comparison followed by the single functor applied to u_R inverse; this is coefficientIntegralInverseIso. Let a:I_g(K_Y) to Roos(g^* red K_Y) be the specified zero-homotopy inverseImageRoosComparisonComplex [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison], and let eta_g:K_X to that Roos complex be the normalized constantWeilChainUnit [def-weil-constant-weil-structure]. Then c.inv composed with a equals eta_g as chain maps, including both cone coordinates.

source.place: Tags 03D6 and 08TC; the parent coefficient-comparison proof and the proved regular-unit APIs of lean/Sheaf/Paper/ConstantWeilStructure.lean.

proof.text: The inverse of c sends the regular unit section to the regular unit section: expand the two single-object identifications and use that the inverse coefficient ring map preserves one.

For every n the composite with inverseImageReductionTheta is pullbackUnitLevel. Apply regular-source extensionality at the terminal pro-etale object; use the defining theta tensor formula, the reduction formula on the unit, and naturality of the pullback unit section along the comma arrow.

Identify the normalized unit with chainUnitCandidate by its uniqueness theorem. Mapping-cocone extensionality reduces the desired equation to the first product coordinate and the shifted second coordinate. Product extensionality and the preceding level equations prove the first; both shifted coordinates are zero by the explicit zero-homotopy lift formula.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientUnit_roos {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g] :
    (coefficientIntegralInverseIso l E g).inv ≫
      inverseImageRoosComparisonComplex l E g (constantWeilIntegralComplex l E Y) =
    constantWeilChainUnit l E g
